data.title: Tamper-Proof Payment Gateway Callbacks
data.summary: Payment webhooks are public URLs — anyone can POST to them. Every callback is verified with an HMAC-SHA256 signature and processed inside a PostgreSQL row lock, so forged or double-clicked confirmations can never mark an unpaid order as paid.
